outcome: Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders in subsequent pregnancies
cohort: The study included singleton pregnancies with a confirmed FIGO PAS diagnosis, matched 1:1 to controls without PAS based on parity, previous CDs, and history of vaginal birth after cesarean, from a single tertiary center (2011-2022).
finding: Primary cesarean delivery performed during labor was associated with a 6.3-fold increased risk of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders in subsequent pregnancies.
mod_finding: Primary cesarean delivery during labor increases the risk of placenta accreta spectrum in subsequent pregnancies six-fold, but showed no significant differences in maternal or neonatal outcomes in subsequent pregnancies compared to elective primary cesarean sections.
